text.tspan: Labor force participation rates: modeled vs. national estimates
Share of the working-age population who are economically active (employed or unemployed). National
estimates are based on each country's own data collection and definitions, while modeled estimates are
produced by the International Labour Organization (ILO) using statistical methods to improve comparability

tspan.tspan: Labour Force Statistics, via World Bank (2026); ILO Modelled Estimates, via World Bank (2026)
Employment is defined in line with the 13th ICLS and includes the production of goods for own use, such as subsistence farming.
